title: security(rbac): RBAC v2 - enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging for private deployments
author: Priya Sharma
description: Context: Customers in regulated regions require cryptographic keys (KMS) and encrypted data to be physically resident in the same region as the workload and audit trails. This PR implements RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS region pinning, strengthens audit logging hooks for KMS operations, and adds a migration path for existing policies in private deployments. Motivation: block accidental cross-region key usage and provide clear audit evidence for compliance reviews. Summary of changes: - Add a formal RBAC v2 policy (rbac/policies/kms_residency_policy.yaml) that expresses 'kms.key_region == resource.region' and a fail-safe audit mode. - Implement a KMS region validator in the authz service (services/authz/validators/kms_region_validator.go) that runs as a pre-authorize check and emits structured audit events on mismatch. - Wire audit logging into the private control plane (services/private-controlplane/audit/kms_audit.go) with fields: actor, action, key_id, key_region, resource_region, decision, reason, request_id. - Add feature-flag 'rbac_v2_kms_enforce' with three rollout modes: off, audit-only, enforce. Default for existing clusters is 'audit-only'. - Add a migration job (tools/migrations/202601_kms_region_pin_migration.go) that scans customer KMS bindings and annotates resources with explicit region tags; job is idempotent and rate-limited. - Update the private-installer templates to surface the feature flag and provide operator guidance (redwood-private-installer/templates/kms-config.tpl). - Add unit and integration tests for validator and migration, and end-to-end smoke tests for private-installer. Rollout plan: 1) Deploy to staging with feature-flag set to audit-only. 2) Run migration job against staging and validate audit events. 3) Canary to 3 small private customers with monitoring and rollback playbook. 4) Gradual ramp to enforce mode once no regressions observed for 2 weeks. Backwards compatibility: Default is audit-only to avoid immediate failures. Enforce mode requires explicit opt-in per-cluster. Migration job ensures most resources are annotated to avoid surprises. Security review: design reviewed by Security (Evan Brooks) and Privacy (Maya Singh). Tests: unit tests covering validator logic, integration tests with mocked KMS endpoints, and an e2e smoke test of the installer. Monitoring/metrics added: rbac.kms_validation.decisions{enforced|audit} and rbac.kms_validation.failures with labels reason and region. Related work: ENG-4821 (RBAC v2 rollout), ENG-5102 (Private deployment compliance), SUP-2345 (customer incident where cross-region KMS usage was allowed). Checklist: - [x] Policy definition added - [x] Validator impl + unit tests - [x] Audit logging wired - [x] Migration job - [x] Private-installer template updates - [x] Docs/upgrade notes added - [x] Metrics and dashboards added - [x] Security review complete
